name: Soulmate
description: An emotional 7-page interactive soulmate journey featuring a personalized handwritten love letter, realistic birthday moon phases calculated from both partners' dates of birth, a symbolic shared full moon, a beautiful memory album, a personal relationship timeline, a unique couple quiz, background music, and a heartfelt final wish.
features: Automatic music playback when browser permits

personOneDOB.help: Used to calculate the moon phase on the first person's birthday.

personTwoDOB.help: Used to calculate the moon phase on the second person's birthday.

welcomeTitle.label: Welcome Main Heading
welcomeTitle.default: Our Story, Written in the Stars

welcomeSubtitle.label: Welcome Message
welcomeSubtitle.default: Some moments become memories. Some people become home.

letterParagraphs.label: Personal Love Letter
default: There are so many things I wish I could tell you, and sometimes words still feel too small.
You have become a beautiful part of my everyday life. Even the simplest moments feel special when they have you in them.
If I could keep one thing forever, it would be the feeling of being able to share this life with you.
letterParagraphs.help: Write your letter. Separate paragraphs with a new line.

moonHeading.default: Two Birthdays. Two Moons. One Story.

moonDescription.label: Moon Page Description
moonDescription.default: The moon was in a different phase on each of your birthdays. Here's what the sky looked like on those dates.

moonMessage.label: Moon Page Personal Message
moonMessage.default: Two different nights, two different skies — and somehow, your stories found a way to meet.

combinedMoonMessage.label: Combined Moon Message
combinedMoonMessage.default: Not a scientific moon phase — just a symbol of two lives sharing one beautiful sky.
